text: maria do you still have my spare key
I think so. It should be in the drawer by the door, unless it fell behind something. Why?
my cousin needs to get in tomorrow to pick up the drill while im at work
he cant make it past 10
Yiorgos?
yes
I'm on at 8 tomorrow so I can't bring it to you before then. I'll look tonight and check.
its fine. he can wait till thursday if he has to

thursday works. after 3
ill be at the shop till 4 but ill leave the door on the latch

ok
Did the boiler ever get sorted, or is it still making that noise?
still noisy. i bled the radiators, didnt do much. gauge is low so probably a leak somewhere
Low how low? If it's under one bar I'd check the valve under the tap before anything else. Mine did the same thing last winter.
prob under. im at a job till late, ill look thurs when i have the key back
dont come early for it lol

ok
Did you check the valve under the tap or only bleed them
only bled them. i think its the pressure valve not the tap but ill see
im on a roof in gazi all day, phone in the van

yiorgos says he cant do thurs at all now. might be next week
dont tell him i said that

ladadika w stelios after this. back late
